summary: The patch addresses the issue of generating module pages for EPUB when `viewcode_enable_epub` is set to False, but there are some minor concerns regarding test coverage and documentation.

issues.description: There are no additional tests added to verify the new behavior when `viewcode_enable_epub` is False for EPUB builds.
The change could benefit from a comment explaining why the function returns early for EPUB builds when `viewcode_enable_epub` is False.
